answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 45519 Country: India Title: Name Question: I would like know the meaning of name Yesrab. I heard it is the name of Yahudi. Please reply. Answer ID: 45519 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 824/824/M=1434) We do not know whether Yesrab is the name of a Jew. However, it is the old name of Madina. It means: thorny, desolate (See Firozul Lughat) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
